task_completion.description: Load the PDB structure 1CRN into PyMOL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL object list shows '1CRN' or 'crambin' and a protein structure is visible in the viewport.

task_completion.description: Color the protein by secondary structure (helices, sheets, and loops in distinct colors).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The protein ribbon/cartoon shows at least three distinct colors corresponding to different structural motifs (e.g., red for helices, yellow for sheets, green for loops).

task_completion.description: Identify and show disulfide bonds as sticks.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Stick representations are visible connecting cysteine residues (specifically at positions 3-40, 4-32, and 16-26).

task_completion.description: Measure the SG-SG distances for the disulfide bonds.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Dashed lines (distance monitors) with numerical labels in Angstroms are visible between the sulfur atoms of the cysteine pairs.

task_completion.description: Save a ray-traced figure to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL console shows a 'ray' command followed by a 'png' or 'save' command to '~/PyMOL_Data/images/crambin_teaching.png'.

task_completion.description: Create a text report with specific structural details.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command shows a file 'crambin_structure_report.txt' containing 3 disulfide bonds, residue pairs (3-40, 4-32, 16-26), distances, and a summary of helices/sheets.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the PyMOL GUI or command line rather than just creating files via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL application window active with the structure being manipulated or commands being typed into the PyMOL prompt.

integrity.description: The report was generated based on measurements taken in the session.
integrity.visual_evidence: The distances in the report match the distance labels visible in the PyMOL viewport.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific file paths requested in the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: Commands or file explorer windows show the exact paths: ~/PyMOL_Data/images/crambin_teaching.png and ~/PyMOL_Data/crambin_structure_report.txt.

privileged_info_for_vlm: Crambin (1CRN) has exactly 3 disulfide bonds. The cysteine residue pairs are: 3-40, 4-32, and 16-26. Expected SG-SG distances are approximately 2.0 to 2.1 Angstroms. The protein contains two alpha-helices and a small beta-sheet. The figure must be saved to ~/PyMOL_Data/images/crambin_teaching.png and the report to ~/PyMOL_Data/crambin_structure_report.txt.
